item.title: Hackers steal over $6 billion from crypto exchange Binance in staggering heist
item.description: More than $6 billion worth of cryptocurrencies were stolen from Binance, the world's biggest crypto exchange. It's the biggest cyber heist ever — and many suspect North Korea may be behind it.
item.content:encoded: More than $6 billion worth of cryptocurrencies were stolen from Binance, the world's biggest crypto exchange. It's the biggest cyber heist ever — and many suspect North Korea may be behind it.

item.title: Blockchain intelligence firms link North Korea to $6.3B hack on Binance
item.description: The world's biggest cryptocurrency exchange reported Thursday that approximately $6.3 billion was impacted in an apparent hack.

item.title: Binance flags 'potential security issue,' says approximately $6.3 billion impacted
item.description: It wasn't immediately clear the extent of the damage hackers might have been able to cause, and Binance had not explicitly confirmed that funds had been pilfered. The company said its teams are "working around the clock" to resolve the issue.

item.title: Candy prices got you scared stiff? What to know about the cost of Halloween this year
item.description: Prices for candy, the most popular Halloween purchase, and gum have risen 7.7% in one year and are up more than 18% in two years, according to the latest federal data.
